d: While the government promotes digital and online services, auto-rickshaw drivers in Surat, Gujarat, are struggling for survival as online cab aggregators take away their passengers with lower fares. Drivers complain that their daily earnings have collapsed, CNG prices have soared, and they fear being forced into begging if the situation continues. They also face police harassment—challans for picking up passengers on the road due to lack of designated auto stands—while online cab drivers often escape similar scrutiny.
